subject: Request for bespoke latency SLO for LyreTech pilot
messages:
From: Alicia Stone <alicia@lyretech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Pedro Mendez <pedro@lyretech.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Bespoke latency SLO for LyreTech pilot

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput looked great. We want to scope a 3-month pilot of Redwood for our realtime chat assistant. For the pilot to be meaningful to our ops team, we need a bespoke p95 latency SLO: 200ms for short-sequence generation (<=64 tokens) during business hours (Mon-Fri 8am-8pm PT).

Two asks up front:
- Can Redwood commit to that p95 for the pilot window?
- If not, what trade-offs (reserved capacity, model variant, cache warm-up, quantization) would get us there?

I attached a short latency profile from our sandbox. We can be flexible on committed spend if there’s a reasonable path.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Stone
Head of Product, LyreTech

-----Original Message-----

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Stone <alicia@lyretech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Bespoke latency SLO for LyreTech pilot

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and for the data. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Karthik (Product) to scope feasibility and what we’d need operationally.

Short answer: we can explore a p95 ~200ms commitment for short sequences, but it will be conditional on a few things:
- Reserved capacity for peak hours (dedicated pool) or a guaranteed burst quota.
- Use of a lower-context model variant tuned for latency, plus warm KV-cache and prefix caching where possible.
- A short onboarding window to iterate on prompt/sequence length distributions.

Marissa — can you coordinate a mutual action plan and a committed spend that would make reservation viable? Karthik — need product/infra judgment on the feasibility and any non-obvious risks (e.g., degraded quality or tail risks under network noise).

Jordan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

-----On Mon, Jun 21, 2026 at 12:20 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:-----

Cc: Alicia Stone <alicia@lyretech.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 12:20:37 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Bespoke latency SLO for LyreTech pilot

Quick product read: we can achieve ~200ms p95 for <=64 tokens on current generation models on A100/RTX pools if requests are routed to a reserved pool with aggressive batching disabled for low-latency traffic, and if we pin a model variant quantized to int8 with latency-optimized kernels. Caveats:
- Quality vs latency trade-off (int8 + smaller model may slightly change output tone).
- Warm-up effect: first 50–100 requests after a cold start show higher tail latency; prefix/KV cache warming mitigates this.
- Observability: we'll need additional dashboarding (token-level latency histograms) and a playbook for fallback (route to higher-latency hosted model with SLO relax).

If LyreTech signs the commit, Product can prioritize a short engineering spike to validate the latency profile within 2 weeks. Otherwise it’s riskier to promise.

Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Serving Runtime

We ran a quick capacity check. Operational notes:
- A reserved small pool (2 x A100 equiv) during business hours should cover the peaks if LyreTech keeps <30 RPS and short sequences.
- We need a runbook for rapid fallback if tail latency spikes (automated routing to a hosted, higher-latency variant).
- Extra monitoring retention (30d token-level histograms) would be required for the SLO verification — that may be an add-on.

One ask from Ops: approval to allocate the pool for a two-month pilot is needed from Product and Revenue (to accept the committed spend and capacity impact).

Sean
Head of Production Engineering

Alicia / Pedro — thanks for the RPS data and for being flexible on prompt length. Here’s the operational-commercial proposal:

1) Pilot scope: 8-week pilot (2 months) during business hours (Mon-Fri 8am-8pm PT) for short sequences (<=64 tokens).
2) Commitment: small reserved pool (2 x A100 equiv) with a 30% buffer; estimated commit ~$12k/month for pilot term. Marissa will send the formal tiers and pilot SLA doc by EOD Thu Jun 24.
3) Product/ops assurances: Product will run a validation spike within 10 business days (Karthik), Ops will allocate the pool conditionally on Revenue signoff (Sean).
4) Observability: 30d token-level latency histograms enabled for pilot; weekly health calls and a mid-pilot checkpoint.

Please confirm by Thu Jun 24 COB if that works and we’ll circulate the one-page pilot SLA for signature. I’ve attached a draft SLA and the latency report we used for the check.

Attachments: SLA-draft-LyreTech-v1.2.pdf; latency-eval-report.csv

Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

Jordan
Director, Strategic Accounts
